# gensrc/CMakeLists.txt
#
# Optional gensrc step (the "Full" build).  When QLA_RUN_GENSRC is ON the
# Python code-generator is run before compilation, regenerating the
# autogenerated source files in the ObjectHandler and QuantLibAddin trees
# (mirroring ohgensrc / qlgensrc in the VS "full" build).  When OFF (the
# default) the build relies on the previously generated files, exactly like
# the VS "basic" build.  gensrc requires Python 3 and writes into the source
# tree, so it can only be enabled when the source tree is writable.
#
# This file only defines the gensrc targets and the QLA_RUN_GENSRC option.
# The dependency wiring (ohlib -> ohgensrc, QuantLibObjects -> qlgensrc) is
# done in the root CMakeLists.txt, after those library targets exist.

option(QLA_RUN_GENSRC "Run gensrc to regenerate addin source before building" OFF)

if(QLA_RUN_GENSRC)
    find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)

    # Directory containing gensrc.py (this directory).
    set(_gensrc_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

    # ObjectHandler code generation (Excel, Doxygen, Loops, ValueObjects).
    add_custom_target(ohgensrc
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_gensrc_dir}/gensrc.py -xdlv --oh_dir=..
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ObjectHandler/gensrc
        COMMENT "Running gensrc for ObjectHandler"
        VERBATIM)

    # QuantLibAddin code generation.  On Windows the Excel target (x) is
    # included; on other platforms only the C++ addin targets are generated
    # (p C++ addin, v ValueObjects, e Enumerations, l Loops, s Serialization),
    # because the Excel target writes into the Windows-only QuantLibXL tree.
    if(WIN32)
        set(_qlgensrc_flags -a)
    else()
        set(_qlgensrc_flags -pvels)
    endif()
    add_custom_target(qlgensrc
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_gensrc_dir}/gensrc.py ${_qlgensrc_flags} --oh_dir=../../ObjectHandler
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/QuantLibAddin/gensrc
        COMMENT "Running gensrc for QuantLibAddin"
        VERBATIM)
    add_dependencies(qlgensrc ohgensrc)
endif()
